Package com.nutri_sci.controller

Class MealController

java.lang.Object
com.nutri_sci.controller.MealController
public class MealController extends Object
Controller for managing meal-related business logic and operations.

The MealController serves as the intermediary between the user interface and the data layer for all meal-related operations. It handles meal validation, ingredient resolution, nutritional calculations, and database persistence while maintaining separation of concerns in the application architecture.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Validating and processing meal data before persistence
  • Resolving ambiguous ingredient names through user interaction
  • Calculating nutritional values for complete meals
  • Managing meal data persistence and retrieval
  • Notifying observers of meal data changes

The controller uses dependency injection for better testability and follows the Model-View-Controller pattern to maintain clean separation between business logic and presentation concerns.

  • Method Details

    • logMeal

      public boolean logMeal(UserProfile user, Date date, String mealType, String rawIngredients, JFrame owner)
      Validates and logs a meal with interactive ingredient resolution.

      This method performs comprehensive meal validation and logging with the following steps:

      1. Validates required fields (meal type and ingredients)
      2. Parses individual ingredient lines
      3. Resolves ambiguous ingredients through user dialogs
      4. Calculates nutritional values for the complete meal
      5. Persists the meal to the database
      6. Notifies observers of the data change

      If any ingredients cannot be found in the database or are ambiguous, the method presents resolution dialogs to the user to clarify their intent before proceeding with the logging operation.

      Parameters:
      user - the user profile associated with this meal
      date - the date when the meal was consumed
      mealType - the type of meal (e.g., "Breakfast", "Lunch", "Dinner", "Snack")
      rawIngredients - the ingredient list in format "100g chicken breast\n200g rice"
      owner - the parent window for displaying dialog boxes
      Returns:
      true if the meal was successfully logged, false if validation failed or user cancelled
